items.title: Mitchel McAllister Interview, 1960-03-19
items.q: Original Jelly Roll Blues and the Jelly Roll Morton up in Chicago.

ctx.x: Jelly Roll. If I didn't, I can't record.
You made my poor mother crazy, you drove my poor daddy blind. Is that what the words I think? Mm-hmm. Original Jelly Roll Blues and the Jelly Roll Morton up in Chicago.
